notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi guys long time no see you,

First of all, I want to announce that we will be participating in the Mexican Entertainment System all this week.

I want to tell you that the demo has been updated with new puzzles and a new inventory system, plus all the feedback you've been giving us over the past few months. I hope you like the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290079/3c7111dd1ca048d1d5110321a364b173f3378088.jpg[/img]

Regards,

Blusagi Team.
